description.value: South Shore Gallery is a free-admission art gallery in the heart of Sooke showcasing original paintings, ceramics, glass, metalwork, jewellery, fibre art, and gifts by over 80 British Columbia artists. The gallery also carries a selection of art supplies and offers professional custom picture framing done entirely on-site by owner Rebecca Hornsby. It is a worthwhile cultural stop for touring cyclists exploring the southern tip of Vancouver Island.
